cc:Work.dc:description: Joint replay of 11 measured acoustic-volume KT rows and eight Matsui-recalibrated Walker pressure-volume rows. The two output residuals are shown separately in GPa. Their reported widths remain error bars; the audit's weighted objective and missing original covariance are not inferred from unweighted RMS. Model grids and modeled S1 pressures are excluded.
